svg.title: Applying the mean to each discrete Fourier basis vector proves this formula. The factor L counts edge occurrences. Paths wrapping around a small torus still count every edge occurrence; the Fourier computation does not require that the path visit distinct sites. The realized block operation is the same tagged path sum under readout, and therefore retains both this factor and all roll multiplicities; a normalized point average would be a different operation. For clarity, the smoothing recurrence also has an explicit source–readout recovery. At every train retain the ordered list of box-roll displacements, with their multiplicities, and the ordered edge occurrences of each line path in the source operation.
